title: Ride-hailing config: layered overrides that drop sibling settings
name: Layered config loading

questions.prompt: We added a Lisbon config file that only raises the surge cap and widens the search radius. The Lisbon rides service now fails to start with "pricing.baseFareCents must be a non-negative integer", even though the file doesn't mention base fares. Ops also say that setting a single RIDES__PRICING__... variable on a healthy city breaks it the same way. Fix load.ts so the tests pass.
